title: contractStates
responsibility: Attaches declared stored scenario states to their covered unit records without loading executable catalogs.

inputs.name: attachContractStates.entries
inputs.description: Mutable query records whose states arrays receive matching declared scenario states. Existing states are appended to, not cleared.

inputs.name: attachContractStates.root
inputs.description: Project root containing specification/scenarios; only its JSON declarations are read, including nested directories.

outputs.name: attachContractStates
outputs.description: Resolves without a return value after appending covered scenario id and state metadata to the supplied records.

errors.name: Filesystem rejection
errors.description: Original Node filesystem error while listing a specification directory, except ENOENT which is treated as empty. The original code and message are preserved.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: A scenario JSON document cannot be read or parsed, or fails the stored scenario schema.
